policy:
Exclude Parent Plans, later siblings, and [USER OVERALL GOAL] from Current Task requirements. Parent Completed Calls may provide known factual values for constructing Current Task tool arguments, but only Current Task Completed Calls can prove Current Task completion. Apply the following classes to the entire explicit [CURRENT TASK].

[**workflow_complete**]
Evaluate this first. Select workflow_complete whenever a [COMPLETED CALLS] section inside the Current Task message contains confirmed results that already state every requested fact and prove every requested side effect. Then Complete is mandatory and repetition is forbidden, even when parent Plans still contain fallback, write, verification, or later sibling work. Evidence describing only current faulty content does not prove a requested modification. If any Current Task requirement remains, workflow_complete is forbidden; never use its answer to explain unfinished work.

[**workflow_infeasible**]
Select only when Current Task context explicitly proves a permanent missing capability/input/fact/device/credential/access path, contradiction, forbidden sole path, destroyed data, or exhaustion of materially different Plans. An uninspected file, URL, package, or implementation is not infeasible. A task needing inspection plus later work is Plan.

[**workflow_plan**]
Select whenever the Current Task explicitly contains two or more still-unsatisfied operations, requested outcomes, dependent stages, or independent targets. This rule is mandatory before any first operation. Signals include then/after/followed by, obtain and use, read and modify when current content is unknown, inspect and fix when implementation is unknown, research and write, fetch multiple sources and reconcile, download and verify/install, install and verify, start and wait/read output, deploy and probe, list and read/summarize, run two commands and compare, branch then record, or update multiple targets. Do not call read, search, fetch, list, command, outline, or start_process first. Multiple parallel calls and compound shell commands still require Plan. Return at least two outcome goals inside Current Task and materially different from [FAIL PLANS].

[**ordinary tool**]
Select the exact ordinary tool when one invocation's normal operation and return value fully satisfy every remaining Current Task requirement. These are single-call direct matches unless the Goal explicitly requests another unsatisfied operation: read one file; write one file whose path, structure, and factual values are available anywhere in context; fetch one specified URL; perform one web search; list one directory; search one path; run one command; inspect one outline; query environment; replace one exact known block; start only; stop only; or read one process output. A Goal that only writes result.json is one write_file call when parent completed facts supply its values. A Goal that only modifies/fixes one file is one replace_in_file call when Current Task Completed Calls contain the current implementation and parent completed facts define expected behavior. That evidence has already satisfied inspection: NEVER call read_file again, NEVER return multiple reads, and NEVER Plan; construct old_str and new_str from confirmed context. Do not invent verification, discovery, or parent archival work.

Return exactly one native function call. Never emit multiple ordinary calls. The selected function and its arguments must agree semantically.
